lots.title: (1) Glengyle Distillery Kilkerran 16 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky, Campbeltown, 46% ABV
lots.seen_in_photos: Single bottle, no box. Noticeably darker, reddish mahogany spirit (much darker than the 2024 bottles). Older-style label layout: side band reads PRODUCT OF SCOTLAND ESTABLISHED 2004, 70cl/700ml, 46% alc/vol, Aged 16 Years roundel. Plain bottle shape without embossed shoulder. Fill in neck, high shoulder to neck. Capsule black, no printed text visible. Back label NZ importer.
lots.text_read: Front: KILKERRAN GLENGYLE DISTILLERY CAMPBELLTOWN, SINGLE MALT SCOTCH WHISKY, 16 AGED YEARS, 70cl/700ml, 46% alc/vol., PRODUCT OF SCOTLAND ESTABLISHED 2004, DISTILLED BY MITCHELL'S GLENGYLE LTD. Back label: Mitchell's Glengyle Ltd. are very proud to be continuing and adding to the great Campbeltown Distilling tradition... Ceann Loch Cille Chiarain... NOT CHILL FILTERED, NO ADDED COLOURING. Proudly Imported by H. L. Milne Ltd, 834 Colombo Street, Christchurch, 8013, NZ. Pregnancy warning. Standard drinks 25.4, 70cl, 46.0%, barcode 6 10854 00135 3.
lots.not_in_title: Different, earlier label design and bottle (no embossed ESTD 2004 shoulder, 'established 2004' side text, 700ml wording) than the 2024 edition; dark sherry-cask colour suggests an earlier sherry-heavy batch (likely around 2020 to 2023 edition, not stated). No edition year given.
lots.title_errors: none (title simply omits the edition year)
lots.unreadable: Edition or bottling year not on visible labels; base code not photographed.
lots.bottling_era: Earlier than the 2024 edition, probably 2019 to 2023 by label design and darker colour
lots.condition: Fill in neck shoulder, capsule intact with minor creasing, no leaks seen
lots.hidden_value_score: Different earlier edition with darker colour, but still a standard 16yo of modest value; collectors may like the older batch but premium is small.
